title: Unique Legends - Resource Pack
description: Resource pack for the “Cobblemon Unique Legends” mod to texture the /ul list interface on client.
body:
![vs-image](https://i.imgur.com/Tmmej7I.png)

## Require

*   [Cobblemon Unique Legends - Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon-unique-legends)

## Description

An optional resource pack for **Unique Legends**, adding custom GUI icons and Pokémon sprites to the server-side unique Pokémon lock interface.

This pack replaces the default vanilla-looking menu items with cleaner visual icons, including search buttons, pagination controls, lock indicators, and Pokémon miniatures inside `/ul list`.

## Features

*   Custom icons for the `/ul list` chest GUI
*   Pokémon miniatures for locked unique Pokémon
*   Visual support for all National Pokédex numbers from 1 to 1025
*   GUI buttons for player search, Pokémon search, pagination, page info, and fallback states
*   Works through `CustomModelData`
*   No gameplay changes
*   Optional client-side visual enhancement

## How It Works

The Unique Legends mod sends specific `CustomModelData` values to GUI items.

This resource pack detects those values and replaces the item textures with custom icons.

Examples:

*   Locked Pokémon use their National Pokédex number as `CustomModelData`
*   Articuno uses `144`
*   Mewtwo uses `150`
*   Rayquaza uses `384`
*   GUI buttons use reserved values like `900001`, `900002`, and so on

Without this resource pack, the mod still works normally using vanilla item icons.

## Credits

Pokémon icon sprites are sourced from the open PokeAPI sprites repository.
